overview.description: The VistaShares Target 15 DRUKMacro Distribution ETF (DRKY) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed ETF employing a global macroeconomic strategy to all cap US equity investing and income generation. The fund holds the top publicly disclosed holdings of the Duquesne Family Office, a private investment firm of Stanley Druckenmiller, and seeks to generate high monthly income using derivatives. DRKY was launched on Oct 8, 2025 and is issued by VistaShares.

data.title: VistaShares Continues to Add to Its “Legends + Income” ETF Suite with the Launch of DRKY
data.text: SAN FRANCISCO & BOSTON & NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--VistaShares launches DRKY ETF, mirrors holdings of private investment firm of Stanley Druckenmiller while seeking high monthly income.

news.t: VistaShares Continues to Add to Its “Legends + Income” ETF Suite with the Launch of DRKY

holdings.infoBox: DRKY is an equity ETF with a total of 69 individual holdings. The top holdings are Natera stock at 26.84%, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company at 9.15%, STMicroelectronics at 7.40%, Seagate Technology Holdings at 4.58%, and Insmed at 4.50%.
